mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file_upload (upload_key, app_id, file_name, file_size, content_type, chunk_size, total_chunks, uploader_id, uploader_username) VALUES (#{uploadKey}, #{appId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{chunkSize}, #{totalChunks}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderUsername})
mapper.select: SELECT chunk_index FROM sys_file_chunk WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY chunk_index
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_file_chunk (upload_id, chunk_index, chunk_size) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkSize})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file_chunk WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file_upload SET status = 1, file_id = #{fileId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
